title: bug: no MoeDaemonSupervisorTest row pins that a surviving old supervisor root refuses a Windows Restart Daemon (OldTree.survivor() includes roots)
description: Test gap found by RF04's QA (qa-952969be, comment-6125c6f7 on task-f3f364a6) and handed to CQ-RF07. The code is correct at 28df02f7, but a mutant that drops `roots` from MoeDaemonSupervisor.OldTree.survivor() passes every existing MoeDaemonSupervisorTest row. Without that term, a supervisor root that survives TerminateProcess could respawn `_run` after Restart Daemon reports success. QA's probes QA1-QA4 (a surviving root in both profiles; a PROTECTED STOP_FAILED signals nothing and gates starts; NOT_STARTED_HERE while a tree is retained; pid 0/-1 is never looked up or signalled) are in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/qa-rf04-qa-952969be/qa-probes.patch with mutant-roots-survivor.log. Adopt them as permanent rows. This is test-only; no production change is expected.
definitionOfDone: MoeDaemonSupervisorTest gains rows equivalent to QA1-QA4; the QA1 row fails when `roots` is dropped from OldTree.survivor() and passes on the unchanged production code.
No production byte changes; `cmd.exe /d /c "cd /d D:\projexts\moes\moe-jetbrains && .\gradlew.bat test --rerun"` exits 0 under the jetbrains-gradle lease.

implementationPlan.description:
Port QA's probes as permanent rows (test only).

Source: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/qa-rf04-qa-952969be/qa-probes.patch, which holds QA1-QA4, written against RF04's tree. It no longer applies at its old hunk: `git apply --check` fails at :1143. Every member it uses still exists in the WinRestart fixture at f7b077f7:
- proc(pid, parent, startSec, survives), own, stop, restart, starts, service, verified(), self, signals(), stops, events and lookup;
- TreeHandle.alive and kills;
- survivor() and restartRefusal();
- S, R, D, STOP_FAILED and NOT_STARTED_HERE.

Insert the four test bodies verbatim right after the W35 row, before the private volumeSpelling helper. Rename them into the file's W numbering, keeping QA's wording:
- W36 a root that survives its kill refuses and gates starts in both profiles (QA1)
- W37 a protected stop failure signals nothing, gates starts, and a later restart clears it (QA2)
- W38 an unverified protected daemon refusal keeps the retained tree and signals nothing (QA3)
- W39 a non-positive daemon json pid is never looked up or signaled on Windows (QA4)

Above W36, add one comment line naming the gap. No other row lets a supervisor ROOT survive: every other `survives = true` handle is D, Q, P or a pid reuser. So dropping `roots` from OldTree.survivor() passed the whole suite (RF04 QA, task-f3f364a6).

Then run only this class, GREEN, on the unchanged production code:
- Hold the jetbrains-gradle lease (mem:convention-jetbrains-gradle-lease). If it is busy, call moe.report_blocked with that resourceId. Release it on every path.
- From the worktree root: W=$(wslpath -w "$PWD") && cmd.exe /d /c "set GRADLE_OPTS=-Xmx512m&& cd /d $W\moe-jetbrains && .\gradlew.bat test --tests com.moe.services.MoeDaemonSupervisorTest --rerun".
- Keep the --tests value unquoted (mem:gotcha-jetbrains-gradle-from-wsl).

If a probe fails on the unchanged code, the current production behavior wins. Adjust only that row's assertions to the current, correct behavior and keep its intent: W36 must still pin the surviving root. Record why in the step note. Never touch production bytes (DoD 2).

Adversarial self-review: one pass over this task's diff.
(a) Each new row fails for a real reason. W36 fails under the roots mutant (step 2). For W37-W39, read OldTree and stopDaemonForRestart and confirm that each row asserts something the code produces, not a fixture default: the refusal text, the absence of kill: events, the gated starts.
(b) Nothing leaks into other rows: only new rows were added, and no fixture or helper changed.
(c) The rows are deterministic: no real sleeps, and no real pid other than self.
(d) The error handling path of each refusal: its exact message comes from survivor() or restartRefusal().
(e) The diff touches only MoeDaemonSupervisorTest.kt.
Record the GREEN run, the mutant result and the gate totals in the completion summary.

reopenReason: Human "move from backlog": CQ-RF07 residual (MoeDaemonSupervisorTest gap for surviving supervisor roots).

executionContract.intendedBehavior:
Four new rows, W36-W39, ported from RF04 QA's probes QA1-QA4, pin four behaviours of the Windows Restart Daemon in MoeDaemonSupervisorTest:
- W36 (QA1): a supervisor root that survives its kill refuses the restart and gates starts, in both profiles.
- W37 (QA2): a protected stop failure signals nothing and gates starts, and a later restart clears it.
- W38 (QA3): an unverified protected daemon refusal keeps the retained tree and signals nothing.
- W39 (QA4): a non-positive daemon.json pid is never looked up or signaled.
Production code is unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: W36-W39 pass on the unchanged production code.
W36 fails when `roots` is dropped from OldTree.survivor() (mutant.sh), and it is the only failed row.
The verify.sh gate exits 0 with JUnit failures + errors = 0.

compatibility: The existing rows W1-W35, N1-N2 and RP* are unchanged.
approvedScope: MoeDaemonSupervisorTest.kt: four new @Test rows after W35, plus one comment line. No fixture or helper change.
reuse: QA's probe bodies (qa-probes.patch) and the existing WinRestart and TreeHandle fixture, unchanged.
sourceAssumptions: MoeDaemonSupervisor.kt (f7b077f7): OldTree.survivor() at :435 is `(runs + roots + tree + watched).firstOrNull(::running)`. The roots are terminated and awaited at :386-387.

MoeDaemonSupervisorTest.kt: WinRestart at :1300, TreeHandle at :1374, restartRefusal and survivor at :1413-1418, and the constants S/R/D/STOP_FAILED/NOT_STARTED_HERE at :1548-1556. The W35 row starts at :1270.
No existing row makes the root S survive: every `survives = true` handle is D, Q, P or a reuser.
